scope: Phase 10C public pointer.drag physical validation after fixing the test-owned fixture compile-only CGPoint/NSPoint near redeclaration

history.s01Cause: test-only Swift fixture compile failure caused by duplicate near overloads for CGPoint and NSPoint; public pointer.drag was not executed and no drag mutation began

publicBoundary.coordinateSpace: primary-display-local logical coordinates with top-left origin

successEvidence.publicResult: DRAG_POSTED with sourcePositionVerified=true, buttonLifecycle=POSTED, dragDelivery=POSTED, releasePosted=true and semanticConsequenceVerified=false
successEvidence.independentDown: AppKit fixture observes exactly one mouseDown
successEvidence.independentDragged: AppKit fixture observes at least one mouseDragged
successEvidence.independentUp: AppKit fixture observes exactly one mouseUp
successEvidence.independentConsequence: fixture marker reaches destination only from delivered AppKit drag events
successEvidence.restoration: fixture restores original pointer and previous frontmost application

resultPolicy.BLOCKED: The macOS/Swift/Accessibility/runtime environment prevents the controlled fixture or public runtime from executing.
resultPolicy.FAIL: A public contract, canonical-coordinate invariant, source verification, low-level result boundary, independent drag delivery/consequence, release safety or restoration invariant fails.
resultPolicy.PASS: The public SDK pointer.drag call satisfies its low-level contract, the independent fixture observes the complete drag lifecycle and consequence, no emergency release is needed, and restoration succeeds.

nextStepOnPass: Promote pointer.drag to PHYSICALLY_VALIDATED using this evidence, then proceed to Phase 10D raw wheel delivery while keeping semantic ui.scroll preferred.
nextStepOnBlockedOrFail: Preserve immutable evidence, diagnose forward, and do not promote pointer.drag.
